summary: State fire tower near Smithfield, Wetzel County, 1925-1946; dismantled and re-erected at Caddell Mountain, Preston County, where it still stands. Original site is private.

facts.design: steel fire observation tower, 80 feet per NHLR and Forest Lookouts (a 1925 pre-construction item said 60 feet)
facts.status_note: Original Carlin Hill site is gone; the tower was moved in 1946 and stands at Caddell Mountain, Preston County

access.note: Original site is listed as private property

events.note: Register build year. A July 1925 item still described construction as pending at Jacksonburg, Wetzel County, with a ranger's dwelling planned at the base
Telephone connection through the Pine Grove system to the Clarksburg office, reported October 1926
Dismantled in summer 1946 at the Carlin Hill site
Moved to Caddell Mountain, Preston County, and re-erected that fall
Caddell Mountain Lookout registered December 12, 2013 as US 979, WV 9; nominated by Ron Stafford
Carlin Hill site registered January 26, 2017 as US 1667, WV 58; nominated by Brian M. Powell

corrections.why: 18.3 m (60 ft) comes from a July 1925 newspaper item describing a tower still pending. NHLR and Forest Lookouts describe the tower that stood at Carlin Hill as 80 feet (24.4 m).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1925 item gives 60 feet for a tower still pending; NHLR and Forest Lookouts give 80 feet for the tower that stood at Carlin Hill. The story uses 80 feet and the correction above.
The 1925 item says Jacksonburg, Wetzel County; the 1926 item and the register say near Smithfield, Wetzel County. Both are in Wetzel County. The story uses the register's Smithfield.
The register spells the Preston County mountain Cadell; NHLR and Forest Lookouts spell it Caddell. The story uses Caddell.

notes_for_editor: Height (60 ft in brief, from a 1925 pre-construction item) is corrected to 80 ft per two later sources. Place name differs (Jacksonburg vs Smithfield), both Wetzel County. Visit status of the Caddell Mountain tower is not in any source read; the story says so. Caddell is Preston County per NHLR, Forest Lookouts and the state list. No new photos added (FFLOS photo credit to Shaun D. Kuhn has no image URL here).
